title: fix: default audio requests to OpenAI TTS instead of paid-only ElevenLabs
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fix: requests with no `model` on `/audio/{text}` and `/v1/audio/speech` now use `openai/tts-1` (Azure, works on Quest Pollen) instead of paid-only `elevenlabs/eleven-v3`.
- Adds a test that keeps the default audio model off `paidOnly`.
- With-timestamps, voice changer, isolator and transcription keep their own route defaults.

| No `model` sent | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Model | ElevenLabs v3 | OpenAI TTS |
| Quest Pollen only | 402 | Works |
| Price | $100 / 1M chars | $15 / 1M chars |
| Default voice `alloy` | Mapped to Rachel | Native |

Evidence (30 days, prod): `/audio/{text}` traffic resolving to eleven-v3 (default or explicit) was 2,990 requests from 343 users, 50% OK. Paid-balance 402s on eleven-v3 hit ~4,700 requests.

Tradeoff: paid users who relied on the default now get OpenAI TTS voices instead of ElevenLabs v3. ElevenLabs-only voice names without a `model` now return a 400. Follows the cheap-default rule: an unqualified request should not land on the expensive tier.

Merge after #16506 or independently; no conflict.

gist.headline: A voice for every wallet
gist.blurb: Leave the model unspecified and the audio routes pick OpenAI TTS. Quest Pollen gets a voice, and `alloy` gets to sound like `alloy`.
gist.summary: Requests without a model on `/audio/{text}` and `/v1/audio/speech` default to Azure-hosted `openai/tts-1` instead of paid-only `elevenlabs/eleven-v3`, while other audio routes keep their own defaults.
gist.impact: Quest Pollen can cover default speech requests instead of receiving a 402; the default costs $15 rather than $100 per million characters and uses the native `alloy` voice.
